title: CreditApplicationSubmitResponse
description: Outcome of a credit application submission, shared by MCP, A2A and PAP. status reports the submission: received or rejected. The optional decision reports the credit outcome separately and may arrive later through the dealer instead. The response never repeats applicant data. A declined outcome here is not the adverse-action notice the creditor must send. Retries replay the complete original result with data.replayed true.

status.description: Submission outcome. received: accepted for processing. rejected: not accepted; no application was created and no credit inquiry was made. An idempotent replay preserves this value.

decision.description: Optional credit outcome known at response time. Absent when the dealer or lender answers later.

outcome.description: pending: under review. prequalified: soft-inquiry indication, not a commitment. approved: approved on the stated terms. conditionally_approved: approved subject to conditions. declined: not approved.

amount_financed.description: Amount financed in whole units of currency.

monthly_payment.description: Estimated monthly payment in currency, to the cent.

currency.description: Currency of amount_financed and monthly_payment. Omitted means USD.

expires_at.description: Last moment the stated terms stand, as an ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 timestamp with timezone offset.

conditions.description: Conditions or stipulations the applicant must see, such as proof of income.

dealer.description: Convenience contact summary for the buyer agent to surface follow-up details to the user.

phone.description: E.164 phone number for buyer follow-up.

replayed.description: True on an idempotent replay. Every other response field repeats the original result. False or absent on the original result. This is the original outcome, not a live application-status lookup.

message.description: Contextual note from the dealer, such as when a finance manager will call.
